report: NEON STRIKE — POST-P12 PRODUCT / GAMEPLAY / UX / VISUAL / ENGINEERING AUDIT
scope: audit-only (no source/test/package.json/asset modified; this report + JSON added)
p11_status: PARTIAL — TWO-DEVICE LAN QA BLOCKED (unchanged, not verified here)
verdict: NOT a polished playable product: correct engine, prototype game
evidence_method: three.js r160 ground-truth projection using the project's own vendor/three.module.js
live runtime probes through the game's own __neon QA API in real Chrome 143 (ANGLE Intel Mesa RPL-P)

camera_ground_truth.note: world +X renders LEFT of screen centre

aim_offset.conclusion: shot ray is a parallel translation of the crosshair ray; miss is constant at all distances

findings.title: Horizontal mouse look inverted
findings.evidence: client/js/game/camera-controller.js:31 `yaw += dx*SENS` vs three.js PointerLockControls `_euler.y -= movementX`; live `lookBy(+100,0)` yaw 0→0.22 swings view to +X which renders at screen-left (582 vs 700)

findings.title: Crosshair and shot ray are different parallel rays
findings.evidence: aimOrigin = player+EYE (combat.js:82-84, server session.js:340-342); crosshair ray origin = camera = pivot - fwd*3.4; measured lateral offset 0.5500 m constant; aimed dummy sits at ndc.x=0.5
findings.impact: shots do not land where you aim

findings.title: Strafe direction mirrored (same root cause)
findings.evidence: shared/movement.js:70-71 wishX=sy*forward+cy*right with right=(cos,-sin) at camera-controller.js:38/48; at yaw 0 D moves +X = screen-left; three.js uses camera matrix column 0

findings.title: No player-visible feedback for multiplayer hits/kills/damage
findings.evidence: client/js/main.js:181 stores MSG.EVENTS for QA only; local predictor targets are training dummies only (TargetRegistry(training,...))

findings.title: Three conflicting shot origins; tracer uses local prediction
findings.evidence: hit=eye ray, crosshair=camera ray, tracer/flash=weapon muzzle; tracer end from local prediction, not authoritative result
findings.impact: aim model is inconsistent, not hybrid

findings.title: Energy Grenade cannot damage enemies
findings.evidence: shared/grenade.js:140 `if (kind === 'player') amount *= cfg.selfDamageScale;`

findings.title: Solo match can never end; no in-game exit
findings.evidence: match.js startMatch accepts 1 player -> {A:[p2],B:[]}; evaluateRound requires teamsComplete; no in-game leave control; main.js:404 auto-enters stage on in_game
findings.impact: observed live: user trapped, required relaunch

findings.title: HUD KILLS/DEATHS come from local prediction in match mode
findings.evidence: hud.js:182-183 unconditional snap.stats/snap.deaths while auth.authoritative is true; no server kill counter exists

findings.title: Round timing transmitted but never displayed
findings.evidence: matchSnapshot emits roundEndsIn/roundDurationMs; hud-state.js ignores both; no DOM element

findings.title: Training dummies baked into the match map
findings.evidence: shared/map.js TRAINING_DUMMIES: dummy-1/2 at x=-16 sit inside spawn A zone

findings.title: No settings subsystem
findings.evidence: only client/index.html:23 disabled button; CAMERA.SENSITIVITY 0.0022 and FOV 74 hardcoded
findings.impact: unplayable for many users; blocks audio volume

findings.title: No audio subsystem
findings.evidence: grep AudioContext|new Audio|.play()|audio over client/ shared/ => 0 matches

findings.title: Own player model has no team identity
findings.evidence: createPlayer() always default cyan mats; only remotes team-coloured (multiplayer.js:145-149)
findings.impact: team identity unclear on own body

findings.title: Two permanently disabled menu buttons
findings.evidence: client/index.html:23-24 SETTINGS + HOW TO PLAY, disabled, 'TEZ KUNDA'

findings.title: No recoil model
findings.evidence: shared/weapons.js has spreadDeg only; no kick/recovery/view punch

findings.title: Asymmetric pitch clamp
findings.evidence: CAMERA.PITCH_MIN -0.95 / PITCH_MAX 0.62 (up capped at 36deg)

findings.title: No scoreboard
findings.evidence: no Tab handler; teams/scores only as a one-line chip

findings.title: No cross-player kill feed
findings.evidence: hud.pushFeed called only from local predictor events

findings.title: No damage direction indicator or low-HP feedback
findings.evidence: hud.js damageFlash only recolours/fades; no direction, HP band only
findings.impact: cannot tell where you were shot from

findings.title: No media queries / no responsive layout
findings.evidence: client/css/hud.css has 0 media queries; all HUD clusters absolutely positioned at fixed offsets

findings.title: FOV and sensitivity hardcoded
findings.evidence: FOV 74 in game/index.js; CAMERA.SENSITIVITY 0.0022

findings.title: Weapon not held by the character
findings.evidence: weapon-view.js mounts at (0.3,1.28,0.18) on the rig; arms never connect

findings.title: No weapon animation / shell / impact decals
findings.evidence: effects.js pools flash/tracer/spark/blast/puff only

findings.title: No respawn/spectate state in round mode
findings.evidence: dead = frozen on own body until next round
findings.impact: UX dead zone in a 5-round match

findings.title: Dead legacy modules retained
findings.evidence: shared/arena.js, client/js/game/arena-mesh.js; smoke.test.js:74-79 asserts non-use

findings.title: Log artifact sprawl
findings.evidence: 40+ PNGs + 12 phase reports in logs/

findings.title: One map, one mode, no unique mechanic
findings.evidence: shared/map.js single map; matches are rounds-to-5

pulse-pistol.note: overtuned: higher per-shot damage AND tighter spread than the rifle

authority_audit.watch_item: polish phases must not add a client-side HP/ammo/score mirror displayed as authoritative; direction may come from the client, origin never may

must_not_change: authoritative server model and intent-only INPUT message
30 Hz sim / 20 Hz snapshot + interpolation + reconciliation
deterministic PRNG spread, hit zones, falloff, cadence, reload/switch state machines
bounded queues/buffers, payload ceilings, idempotent match transitions, duplicate-close guards
shadowMap off + blob shadows, DPR cap, pooled effects, instanced map geometry
single shared/ source of rules for client and server
[hidden]{display:none!important} and the server-driven HUD state path
180deg centre-point map symmetry and its tests
rebuild: aim/origin model (one converged ray, server-owned origin)
horizontal basis (one shared helper, remove two duplicated right constants)

roadmap.name: Combat Feel + Multiplayer Feedback
acceptance: hitmarker within one snapshot on PvP hit
grenade damages enemies exactly once with falloff
HUD kills == server kills after N kills

roadmap.name: Character + Animation
acceptance: weapon held and aligned to aim ray

roadmap.name: Map Gameplay + Match Flow
acceptance: catwalk has 2 routes and a reason
solo start has a defined tested outcome

roadmap.name: HUD / Menu / Settings / UX
acceptance: phase labels removed from player copy
HUD fits 1024x600 and 1280x720 with centred crosshair

roadmap.name: Audio + VFX
acceptance: all priority cues present and volume-controlled
lazy init keeps headless verifiers working

roadmap.name: Final QA / Release Hardening
acceptance: all verifiers green with actual counts

principles: yaw via Euler YXZ with _euler.y -= movementX

design_principles_sources.source: Valorant vs Counter-Strike map design analysis (amist.co, Riot level design context)
principles: bound maximum engagement distance (~2/3 of Dust2)
standardise chokepoint widths so one utility can contest them
raise density of angles/corners to check
avoid impenetrable headshot-only cover; prefer penetrable cover
spawn areas are large but their cost is absorbed by a buy phase (Neon Strike has none)
give each map a unique mechanic

limitations: no vision: visual judgements are structural + state-based; screenshots captured for human review
B-03 (strafe mirroring) is source-derived, not runtime-verified with real WASD input
the MENYUGA re-entry trap (B-07) is explained mechanically but was not deliberately reproduced
P11 two-device LAN QA still NOT performed — unchanged
no profiler used; performance numbers are the project's own P10 instrumentation plus live reads
